findings.claim: 20-F FY2025 風險因素：市場高度競爭，對手有些資源更多；市場成長可能吸引新進入者；另有本地小型競爭者主攻低階市場、以較低價格供貨；競爭可能壓低價格與毛利。
findings.excerpt: The continued growth of the markets in which we operate may attract and result in new market entrants and may also encourage existing competitors to expand their efforts and presence in these markets.

findings.claim: 20-F 風險因素：另有本地小型競爭者鎖定低階市場並以較低價格供貨。
findings.excerpt: Other competitors are local smaller competitors in the markets we operate, which target the low-end market and may offer products at lower prices.

findings.claim: Q1 2026 財報電話會議：管理層稱維持 3D 凸塊量測領先並在 2D 檢測持續拿更多份額（公司自述）
findings.source: Camtek Q1 2026 Earnings Call Transcript (Insider Monkey)
